summary: Tyler Lundstedt, 24, was killed in a snowmobile avalanche near Buffalo Pass in the Park Range. His family memorial foundation (Backcountry Awareness) confirms the date, location, and fatality; the avalanche-center 2011-12 incident index independently records a Jan-21 Park Range snowmobiling fatality.
notes: Run 657 chunk A (Steamboat Pilot/Routt thin-year mine). COUNTY FLAG: Buffalo Pass summit straddles the Routt/Jackson county line; Routt assigned given the Steamboat-side (Buffalo Pass Road) access but not confirmed by a county-source. Responding agency unknown — the two corroborating sources name no responder; Routt County SAR is the likely agency but unverified. Distinct from id 2327 (2012-01-21 Chedsey Creek, North Park on-foot avalanche, Jackson County) — different incident, same day. No dated newspaper/Pilot mirror found; detailed avalanche-center report is membership-walled (not accessed). Fills Routt 2012 zero-row status. County corrected Routt->Jackson run 677: Kathryn's Report (republishing the Jan-2012 Steamboat Pilot article, parent-opened) states Lundstedt was found 'on the east side of Buffalo Pass west of Walden' — the Jackson County side. His brother Jordan Lundstedt of Fort Collins survived two nights in a snow cave with frostbite and was extracted by helicopter Monday night (2012-01-23) to the NCMC burn unit in Greeley.
